text: This S1000D Business Rules Exchange (BREX) document defines business rules and constraints for the s1kd-tools system. It specifies system nomenclature codes for 29 s1kd software tools and establishes structural validation rules for document identifiers, including mandatory model code "S1KDTOOLS," system difference code "A," and alphanumeric character requirements for variant codes.

This S1000D document describes the **s1kd-newimf** tool, a command-line utility for creating S1000D ICN (Illustrative Content Notation) metadata files. It specifies the tool's purpose, usage syntax, and comprehensive command-line options for configuring output path, S1000D issue version, security classification, originator details, and XML parser settings. The document includes practical examples and references related configuration files.

This S1000D document describes the **s1kd-sns** tool, a command-line utility for organizing S1000D data modules into hierarchical directory structures based on SNS (Subject Number System) classifications. It details the tool's purpose, usage syntax, command-line options (including copy/move/link modes, output directory configuration, and XML parser settings), and provides a practical example showing SNS hierarchy output.
